registered_before: any physical outcome of a new argmax query (multipass running; no new teacher call made)

frozen_inputs.candidate_pool: M4 proposals of the sealed FULL_s0 prediction per root (pool_hash checked)
frozen_inputs.scorers: FULL_s0..2 = frozen bundle D (pins in config/final_protocol.yaml); E_s0..2 and DIRECT_s0..2 = sealed ablation fits

selection_key: exhaustive.key with alpha=beta=gamma=0: (round(-log max(p,1e-12),12), |r|, displacement, signature); label-blind
decision_from_scores: NOOP if p_noop>=gate; else the higher of (argmax repair, NOOP; NOOP wins ties) among those with p>=eta; else ABSTAIN
physical_queries: argmax repair of every score variant on every eval_task (K1-K3) root of VAL and TEST; union minus the existing cache; unchanged teachers via benchmark.teach; query list hashed before teaching; no retry; UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN

variants.A5_knockout: FULL_s*: p11_w0 = sig(b) sig(a) (w <- 0), NOOP probability unchanged

D_selectors.Y_only: sig(b_endpoint); permutations of one endpoint tie and are broken by the label-blind key

B2_threshold_tuning.unit: per model checkpoint (seed); D-family tuned identically as the control
B2_threshold_tuning.objective: mean of task success (K1-K3), correct NOOP (K0), correct ABSTAIN (NONE) = evaluate.tune objective of the frozen rule
B2_threshold_tuning.tie_break: smallest L1 distance to the registered rule (0.5, 0.3), then lower gate, then lower eta
B2_threshold_tuning.test_use: tuned rules frozen (hashed) before any TEST metric of a tuned rule is computed; TEST is historically exposed -> exploratory

D_decision_protocol.primary: threshold-free repair-forced top-1 physical success on eval_task roots (argmax of each score)
D_decision_protocol.secondary: fixed gating: NOOP/ABSTAIN/REPAIR type taken from FULL_s* under the registered rule; only the repair candidate is replaced by the variant's argmax

statistics: paired root differences, seed-averaged where seeds exist, cluster bootstrap over layout_root_id (2,000, seed 0) with a parent_family_id sensitivity; K1/K2/K3 separately; exploratory unless stated
multiplicity: Bonferroni-adjusted 99.86% intervals reported next to 95% for the 36 registered ablation cells; new diagnostics are exploratory
